literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe a BirA* biotin-ligase fused to the C-terminus of full-length CA9. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the C-terminus (residues 436–459) is intracellular; the tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. The FACS result in L2 confirms robust surface trafficking of the full-length fusion protein but does not place the tag on the extracellular face. No ledger line reports any insertion in the extracellular domain (residues 38–414) or at the mature N-terminus (residue 38). Because the ledger contains no evidence of a tolerated tag on the extracellular face, zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: BirA* fused to the C-terminus of full-length CA9; the C-terminal tail (residues 436–459) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this fusion faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
